summary: Iteration 8: Comprehensive testing of DocuSite web application per new brief requirements. Verified Spanish homepage copy against BRIEF sections 5.1-5.14, new pricing (2 free/month, €49/10, €199/50, €690/200, single €6.9), new brand colors (#14181C, #F4F2EE, #FF8A3D), Archivo & Inter fonts loaded locally, PDF gate with Radix checkboxes, calculator (10 docs = 15h = €675), analytics events, admin panel, 51 routes with ES/CA/EN + hreflang, production build validation. All backend tests passed (58/58). Frontend tests passed with correct implementation of all BRIEF requirements.
